title: [Release-coverage patrol] published-minor section coverage — generated view (please pin)
body:
os-release-coverage-sweep — machine-findable marker for this generated view.

**Generated view — not a second tracker.** This body is rewritten IN PLACE by the scheduled patrol workflow (`.github/workflows/release-coverage-patrol.yml`) on every run, and the edit history is the archive. **Report-only**: every finding is patrol input, never a gate verdict. This sweep never writes release prose — it cannot, and the gate's own header explains why (a curated section is a judgement about what is user-facing, read out of the per-package changelogs).

# ✅ Every published minor has its section

_Swept 2026-09-18T04:31:58.017Z · expected every 24h (cron `19 4 * * *` UTC) · next by 2026-09-19T04:19Z · run [35307305763](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/35307305763) · commit `600b1e2ab129008e9d43e7101be35d22befe2142` · trigger `schedule`_

No findings. Every in-scope GA minor has a heading on its major's release page, and every index entry names the newest release of its major.

```
check-release-section-coverage: OK — 7 published minor(s) across 2 GA major(s) in scope (v16, v17); every one has a heading on its major's release page, and every index entry names the newest release of its major.
Instrument: packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md (GA = a version heading with no prerelease suffix).
Scope: v16 and later ONLY, INHERITED from scripts/check-release-page-status.mjs rather than chosen here — maintainer ruling 2026-08-15, quoted verbatim and untranslated: 「只负责 v16 以后的，需要的话之前的版本删除也可以的」. Below the floor this assertion has 24 uncovered minors to report (v9, v12, v13, v14), so inheriting the floor is what lets this gate ship with NO baseline and NO exception list. Do not move it without a new ruling, and do not move it on one gate only.
```

The `Swept` line above is this patrol's heartbeat, and it states the cadence that makes 「stalled」 decidable: a timestamp still sitting there past the `next by` deadline beside it means the standing caller died, which is the failure this anchor exists to make visible. ⛔ Do not carry a cadence over from a sibling patrol anchor — they differ by up to 4× and each states its own. Read it before you read the findings.
